description: This file defines classes and functions for serializing and deserializing lists of bytes, including checksum validation, using a custom binary format. It includes helper classes BytesWriter and BytesReader, and a generic class AppendingByteSerializer for efficient byte list handling.

classes.name: BytesWriter
classes.description: Handles writing data to a byte array with checksum calculation.

classes.name: BytesReader
classes.description: Handles reading and validating data from a byte array with checksum verification.

classes.name: AppendingByteSerializer
classes.description: Provides serialization and deserialization of byte lists with versioning and checksum.

methods.name: BytesWriter.write_uint64
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer to the byte array.

methods.name: BytesWriter.write_str
methods.description: Encodes a string in base64 and writes it as bytes.

methods.name: BytesWriter.write_bytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array preceded by its length.

methods.name: BytesWriter.to_bytes
methods.description: Finalizes the byte array with checksum and returns bytes.

methods.name: BytesReader.is_finished
methods.description: Checks if all data has been read.

methods.name: BytesReader.read_bytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array preceded by its length.

methods.name: AppendingByteSerializer.__init__
methods.description: Initializes serializer with a serialization function.

methods.name: AppendingByteSerializer.clear
methods.description: Resets the internal writer and writes version.

methods.name: AppendingByteSerializer.to_bytes
methods.description: Returns the serialized data as bytes.

methods.name: AppendingByteSerializer.to_list
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into a list of data elements.
